panels.title: Provider capacity
panels.description: The capacity of every account, one card per account and one row per capacity window of the account, and the free models the provider holds apart from its paid allowance. The share that is left, the line of the even spend, the reset and the age of the reading are the collector's account window gauges, and the pace reads the difference between the two. An account that publishes no window of its own is learning, and says so in one line under the cards.

panels.title: Model selection
panels.description: The owner's static selection, shown while the routing is off and kept for reference while it is on: one row per route of the policy, in the collector's row order, and under a Free divider one row per free provider with the model it selected for the free tier. The role, the model and its tag, the provider with the icon of its capacity card, the work the route is used for, and the share of its binding window that is left with the collector's Paced Availability beside it. A route the snapshot does not carry has no reading, never a zero; a free provider that is still learning its window, or has no eligible free model, says so.

panels.title: Bulk · who gets the next coding job
panels.description: The bulk tier: the route the next coding job goes to. The order is the collector's own winner position, never a ranking made here; the routes that are not winners follow them, and a route that is spent or refused sinks to the bottom with its reason. The fill of a bar is the share left now, the line in it is the share the window expects to be left now, and the pace reads the Paced Availability between the two.

panels.description: The free tier: the pool that answers with one response. The order is the collector's own winner position; the basis column names where the limit of a route comes from, and the AA column its measured intelligence. A route whose limits are unknown says so and never shows a zero. The line in a bar is the Paced Availability of the window.
